text:
Alex Kim: Heads-up — PR #19833 is blocked by CI. Windows snapshot test failing on windows-shard-4 (kv-cache-large). Can someone triage or approve a targeted rerun?

CI Bot: [CI] buildkite: job failed — windows-2022 shard-4. Test: tests/kv_cache_test.go::TestCacheConsistency. Artifact: https://ci.example/builds/12345/artifacts

Maya Patel: on it, grabbing logs now. do we have a repro locally or is this only in CI?

Sam Ortega: saw a similar flake yesterday on shard-6 — timing-sensitive race, not deterministic. sometimes a disk flush boundary adds an extra placeholder entry.

Julian Park: quick glance at the artifact shows a snapshot diff:
```
- expected: [a,b,c]
+ actual:   [a,b,c,null]
```
looks like an extra null appended before eviction. not safe to accept as snapshot update.

Priya Rao: prefer rerun first. @Alex can you trigger a targeted rerun for shard-4?

Alex Kim: doing targeted rerun now: `bk retry --build 12345 --job windows-shard-4` — kicked it off. pinging once it's started.

CI Bot: Rerun started (build 12347). Running 1/1 jobs: windows-shard-4.

CI Bot: Rerun results: 2/3 attempts passed, 1/3 still failing on snapshot compare. Artifacts at https://ci.example/builds/12347/artifacts

Maya Patel: pulled the artifacts. failure is `len(results) == 3` vs `4`. Looks nondeterministic. we should make the test robust rather than update snapshot.

Julian Park: quick mitigation: sort results before compare in test to remove ordering nondeterminism. e.g. replace compare with:
```
sorted := sortStrings(results)
assert.Equal(t, expectedSorted, sorted)
```
that should stabilize.

Sam Ortega: I can open a small PR to make that change. but for PR #19833 itself — options: hold merge, force-merge with CI override (not ideal), or remove the snapshot file from this PR and land the rest.

Alex Kim: it's a perf regression fix, would like to land this week. proposal: remove the snapshot changes from this PR, land, then follow-up with Sam's deterministic-fix PR. thoughts?

Priya Rao: sounds reasonable. timeline ok for holding until Monday otherwise.

Maya Patel: I can approve if snapshot files are removed from this PR. ping once you push the cleanup. :+1:

Alex Kim: removed the snapshot file and force-pushed (branch: feat/kv-fix -> pushed). please review.

Sam Ortega: quick scan now — lgtm for the non-snapshot diff. approving. :white_check_mark:

CI Bot: Merge queued. Full CI started (build 12350). ETA ~12m.

CI Bot: All checks passed. PR #19833 merged by Alex Kim. :tada:

Alex Kim: thanks all. created follow-up issue to make the test deterministic: ISSUE-4137. tagging Sam to pick up the test fix. closing this thread.

Julian Park: thanks — good call to avoid blind snapshot updates.

Priya Rao: reassigning follow-up to Sam.

Maya Patel: resolved. :relieved:
